definitions.full: H6497. peqaim מְּקָעִים noun masculine 1Kin 7:24 plural carved wood or metal ornaments, either ball-, knob-shaped (Löw p. 332 f. ) of gourd-shaped (so most; compare following; Syriac flowers [Lexicons]); — 1Kin 6:18 ; 7:24 (twice in verse).
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to burst; only used as an architectural term of an ornament similar to 6498 ,
